class: A list the agent never looked at
symptom: A required dropdown ("If you are under 18 years of age, can you provide proof of your eligibility to work?") was left for the owner: Claude said its choices were unknown.
root_cause: The page draws such a dropdown as a bare button named "Choose an option" and builds its list only when opened, so the snapshot Claude planned from held no choices. A question the profile could settle went back to the owner for want of a list nobody opened.
why_tests_missed: The dropdown fixtures were native selects or lists drawn open, where the choices are always in the snapshot.
fix: read_hidden_choices opens each blank prompt-named dropdown that shows no choices (at most twice), reads the whole list, closes it without choosing (Escape, then the control itself), and gives Claude the question (label_above) and the choices. Choosing stays with the planner's answer and choose().
prevention: Before asking anyone a question about a list, open the list and read it whole. Give the planner the choices along with the question, and have the planner's answer checked against them.
